$comment: Entitlement matrix for PyArcana subscription plans as they relate to the supervisor / cohort system. Generated by product_hardening Phase 2. The matrix is consulted by src/lib/permissions.ts and the cohort API routes.

free.label: Free
free.$comment_canBeReporterInOtherCohort: A Free user may be invited as a COHORT_REPORTER to a Team-tier cohort without upgrading. This is a deliberate differentiator vs. Coursera/DataCamp/Pluralsight/Udemy which all bill reporter seats at full learner price.

downgradeBehavior.$comment: What happens to a supervisor's cohorts when their subscription downgrades.
downgradeBehavior.$comment_gracePeriodDays: During the grace period, archived cohorts remain read-only. The owner can export member lists. After the grace period, the cohorts remain archived (not deleted) indefinitely. Memberships are NOT auto-removed.
downgradeBehavior.$comment_deletionPolicy: Cohort rows and CohortMembership rows are never auto-deleted. Only the cohort status changes to ARCHIVED. This preserves audit history indefinitely.

upgradeBehavior.$comment: What happens when a supervisor upgrades.

freeToPro.$comment_autoUnarchiveCohorts: Upgrading does NOT auto-unarchive cohorts that were archived due to a prior downgrade. The owner must explicitly request unarchive via admin (Phase 7+).

reporterSeatPolicy.$comment: A COHORT_REPORTER is a read-only member of a cohort. The reporter does not need their own Pro or Team subscription.
reporterSeatPolicy.$comment_reporterMaxCohorts: A single user can be a reporter in up to 10 cohorts to prevent abuse (e.g. someone scraping data across many cohorts).

staticSiteBehavior.$comment: The static GitHub Pages export does not include any supervisor features. The UI hides supervisor surfaces when IS_STATIC_SITE === true.
staticSiteBehavior.$comment_notificationsStoredLocally: Notifications are server-only. The static site has no notification surface.
